import asyncio
import os
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, Playwright, Browser, Page

async def automate_bookmyshow():
    browser: Browser = None
    page: Page = None
    try:
        # Ensure screenshots directory exists
        screenshots_dir = "screenshots"
        if not os.path.exists(screenshots_dir):
            os.makedirs(screenshots_dir)

        async with async_playwright() as playwright:
            browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True) # Set headless=False for visual debugging
            page = await browser.new_new_page()

            # Step 1: Navigate to BookMyShow homepage
            print("Step 1: Navigating to BookMyShow homepage...")
            await page.goto("https://in.bookmyshow.com/")
            await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
            await page.screenshot(path=os.path.join(screenshots_dir, "01_homepage_loaded.png"))
            print("Successfully navigated to BookMyShow homepage.")

            # Step 2: Handle city selection and ensure Mumbai is selected
            print("Step 2: Handling city selection (trying to select Mumbai if prompted)...")
            city_modal_selector = "div.bms-modal-block" # Common selector for the city selection modal
            mumbai_city_option_selector = "div.bms-modal-block >> text='Mumbai'" # Specific text within the modal

            try:
                # Wait for the city selection modal to appear (with a timeout)
                await page.wait_for_selector(city_modal_selector, timeout=5000)
                print("City selection modal detected. Clicking on 'Mumbai'.")
                await page.click(mumbai_city_option_selector)
                await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
                print("Clicked 'Mumbai'.")
                await page.screenshot(path=os.path.join(screenshots_dir, "02_after_city_selection.png"))
            except Exception:
                print("City selection modal not found or already dismissed. Assuming Mumbai is active or will be handled later.")
                # Verify if Mumbai is already displayed in the header, or proceed
                mumbai_header_selector = "span.profile-city-name:has-text('Mumbai')"
                try:
                    await page.wait_for_selector(mumbai_header_selector, timeout=3000)
                    print("Mumbai is already selected in the header.")
                except Exception:
                    print("Mumbai not explicitly found in header, proceeding with caution.")
                await page.screenshot(path=os.path.join(screenshots_dir, "02_city_selection_confirmed.png"))
            
            # Step 3: Click on the search icon and type "Border 2"
            print("Step 3: Clicking search icon and typing 'Border 2'...")
            search_icon_selector = "span.icon-search" # Common selector for the search icon
            search_input_selector = "input#superstar-search-box" # Common selector for the search input field

            await page.wait_for_selector(search_icon_selector)
            await page.click(search_icon_selector)
            print("Clicked on the search icon.")
            
            await page.wait_for_selector(search_input_selector)
            await page.fill(search_input_selector, "Border 2")
            print("Typed 'Border 2' into the search bar.")
            
            await page.keyboard.press("Enter") # Press Enter to submit the search
            await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
            await page.screenshot(path=os.path.join(screenshots_dir, "03_after_search_query.png"))
            print("Search query submitted for 'Border 2'.")

            # Step 4: Click on the "Border 2" movie result from search suggestions/results
            print("Step 4: Clicking on 'Border 2' movie result...")
            # Selector looks for a link that contains '/movies/' in its href and 'Border 2' in its text
            movie_result_link_selector = "a[href*='/movies/']:has-text('Border 2')"
            
            await page.wait_for_selector(movie_result_link_selector)
            await page.click(movie_result_link_selector)
            await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
            await page.screenshot(path=os.path.join(screenshots_dir, "04_movie_details_page.png"))
            print("Navigated to 'Border 2' movie details page.")

            # Step 5: Verify show availability and take a screenshot of the show times section
            print("Step 5: Checking for show availability and taking a screenshot.")
            # This selector looks for either a dedicated showtimes section or a prominent 'Book Tickets' button
            show_availability_indicator_selector = "section.showtimes-section, button.book-button-full-width" 
            
            await page.wait_for_selector(show_availability_indicator_selector, timeout=15000)
            print("Show availability indicator (showtimes section or 'Book Tickets' button) found.")
            await page.locator(show_availability_indicator_selector).scroll_into_view_if_needed()
            await page.screenshot(path=os.path.join(screenshots_dir, "05_showtimes_or_book_tickets.png"))
            print("Screenshot taken of the showtimes/booking section.")
            print("Script completed successfully.")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An error occurred during automation: {e}")
        if page:
            await page.screenshot(path=os.path.join(screenshots_dir, "error_screenshot.png"))
        raise # Re-raise the exception after logging and screenshot

    finally:
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
            print("Browser closed.")

async def main():
    await automate_bookmyshow()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

import asyncio
import os
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, Page, expect

async def main():
    browser = None
    try:
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True) # Set to False for visual debugging
            page = await browser.new_page()

            # Step 1: Navigate to BookMyShow
            print("Step 1: Navigating to BookMyShow...")
            await page.goto("https://in.bookmyshow.com/", timeout=60000) # Increased timeout for initial load
            await page.screenshot(path="screenshots/01_bookmyshow_homepage.png")
            print("Screenshot taken: 01_bookmyshow_homepage.png")

            # Step 2: Handle city selection - try to select Mumbai
            print("Step 2: Attempting to select Mumbai city...")
            mumbai_selected = False
            try:
                # Common selectors for city selection pop-up / banner
                # Attempt to click on 'Mumbai' if it appears in a city selection modal or banner
                # This combines several common locator patterns for Mumbai across different BMS layouts.
                mumbai_locator_xpath = (
                    "//div[contains(@class, 'commonModal__container')]//div[contains(text(), 'Mumbai')] | "
                    "//div[contains(@class, 'city-item')]//span[contains(text(), 'Mumbai')] | "
                    "//a[contains(@class, 'select-city') and text()='Mumbai'] | "
                    "//li[contains(@class, 'city-name')]/span[text()='Mumbai'] | "
                    "//div[contains(@class, 'region-filter')]//span[text()='Mumbai']"
                )
                mumbai_element = page.locator(mumbai_locator_xpath).first

                await mumbai_element.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=10000) # Wait for the element to be visible
                await mumbai_element.click(timeout=5000)
                print("Clicked on 'Mumbai' for city selection.")
                mumbai_selected = True
                await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle', timeout=15000)

            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Mumbai city selection element not found in expected pop-up/banner. Trying dropdown or assuming already selected/no prompt. Error: {e}")

            if not mumbai_selected:
                # Fallback: Check if city dropdown at top needs to be clicked and then Mumbai
                try:
                    # Locate the current city displayed at the top
                    city_dropdown_locator = page.locator("//div[contains(@class, 'styles__CityWrapper')]/span | //span[contains(@class, 'user-chosen-city')] | //div[contains(@class, 'location-icon')]/following-sibling::span | //span[contains(@class, 'sc-jtykGq')]")
                    await city_dropdown_locator.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=5000)
                    current_city_text = await city_dropdown_locator.inner_text()

                    if "Mumbai" not in current_city_text:
                        print(f"Current city is '{current_city_text}'. Attempting to change to Mumbai via dropdown.")
                        await city_dropdown_locator.click()
                        # Wait for the dropdown options to appear and click Mumbai
                        mumbai_in_dropdown = page.locator("li.city-name span", has_text="Mumbai").first
                        await mumbai_in_dropdown.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=5000)
                        await mumbai_in_dropdown.click()
                        print("Clicked Mumbai from top dropdown.")
                        mumbai_selected = True
                        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle', timeout=15000)
                    else:
                        print(f"City already set to '{current_city_text}'. Proceeding.")
                        mumbai_selected = True # Already in Mumbai
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"City dropdown not found or Mumbai not selectable from it. Assuming current city is fine or continuing. Error: {e}")

            if not mumbai_selected:
                print("Could not confirm Mumbai selection. Script will proceed, but city might be incorrect.")

            await page.screenshot(path="screenshots/02_city_selected.png")
            print("Screenshot taken: 02_city_selected.png")

            # Step 3: Search for "Border 2"
            print("Step 3: Searching for movie 'Border 2'...")
            # Locate the search icon or search bar. Combines different common selectors.
            search_icon_selector = "//div[contains(@class, 'Header__SearchInputContainer')] | //div[contains(@class, 'sc-bBHHxW')]/div[contains(@class, 'sc-fubCfw')] | //div[contains(@class, 'search-container')] | //span[contains(@class, 'search-icon')] | //div[contains(@class, 'sc-hORPGm')]"
            search_input_selector = "[data-qa-id='search-input'] | [data-cy='search-bar'] | #search-bar-input | input[placeholder*='Search for Movies'] | input[placeholder*='Search for Movies, Events, Plays']"

            search_bar_element = None
            try:
                # Try to click a search icon/container first if it exists to reveal the input
                search_icon = page.locator(search_icon_selector).first
                await search_icon.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=5000) # Wait for search icon/container to be visible
                print("Clicking search icon/container...")
                await search_icon.click(timeout=5000)
                # Now wait for the actual input field to appear after clicking the icon
                search_bar_element = page.locator(search_input_selector).first
                await search_bar_element.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=5000) # Wait for the input to be visible
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Search icon/container not found or clickable, trying to locate search input directly. Error: {e}")
                search_bar_element = page.locator(search_input_selector).first
                await search_bar_element.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=5000) # Wait for the input directly

            await search_bar_element.fill("Border 2")
            print("Typed 'Border 2' into search bar.")
            await page.screenshot(path="screenshots/03_typed_movie_name.png")
            print("Screenshot taken: 03_typed_movie_name.png")

            # Step 4: Click on the movie "Border 2" from search results
            print("Step 4: Clicking on 'Border 2' from search results...")
            # Selector for the movie result link, looking for a link containing /movie/ and the exact text 'Border 2'
            movie_result_selector = "//a[contains(@href, '/movie/') and (text()='Border 2' or contains(@title, 'Border 2'))]"
            movie_result = page.locator(movie_result_selector).first
            await movie_result.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=10000) # Wait for the specific movie result to appear
            await movie_result.click(timeout=5000)
            print("Clicked on 'Border 2' search result.")
            await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle', timeout=15000)
            await page.screenshot(path="screenshots/04_movie_details_page.png")
            print("Screenshot taken: 04_movie_details_page.png")

            # Step 5: Check for show availability
            print("Step 5: Checking for show availability...")
            # Look for common elements indicating showtimes or booking options on the movie details page
            showtime_indicators = [
                "//div[contains(@class, 'showtime-card')]",
                "//button[contains(text(), 'Book Tickets')]",
                "//div[contains(@class, 'show-details')]",
                "//div[contains(@class, 'showtimes-day')]",
                "//section[contains(@class, 'venue-details')]",
                "//div[contains(@class, 'show-timings')]",
                "//a[contains(@class, 'select-show') or contains(@class, 'show-time-pill')]"
            ]

            showtimes_found = False
            for selector in showtime_indicators:
                try:
                    # Wait for any of the showtime indicator elements to become visible
                    await page.wait_for_selector(selector, state="visible", timeout=10000)
                    print(f"Showtime indicator found: {selector}")
                    showtimes_found = True
                    break # Found an indicator, no need to check others
                except Exception:
                    continue # Try the next selector

            if showtimes_found:
                print("Movie details page loaded and showtime indicators are present.")
                await page.screenshot(path="screenshots/05_showtimes_available.png")
                print("Screenshot taken: 05_showtimes_available.png")
                print("Script completed successfully: Showtimes for 'Border 2' in Mumbai should be visible.")
            else:
                raise Exception("Could not confirm showtime availability on the movie details page. No expected showtime indicators found.")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\nAn error occurred during automation: {e}")
        if 'page' in locals() and page: # Check if page object exists before trying to screenshot
            try:
                await page.screenshot(path="screenshots/error_final.png")
                print("Screenshot taken: error_final.png")
                print(f"Last known URL: {page.url}")
            except Exception as screenshot_e:
                print(f"Failed to take error screenshot: {screenshot_e}")
        raise # Re-raise the exception after logging and screenshot

    finally:
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
            print("Browser closed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Ensure the screenshots directory exists
    if not os.path.exists("screenshots"):
        os.makedirs("screenshots")
    asyncio.run(main())

import asyncio
import os
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, Playwright, expect

async def main():
    playwright_instance: Playwright | None = None
    browser = None
    page = None

    # Create screenshots directory if it doesn't exist
    if not os.path.exists("screenshots"):
        os.makedirs("screenshots")

    try:
        playwright_instance = await async_playwright().start()
        browser = await playwright_instance.chromium.launch(headless=False, args=['--start-maximized'])
        page = await browser.new_page()
        await page.set_viewport_size({"width": 1920, "height": 1080})

        print("Navigating to BookMyShow...")
        await page.goto("https://in.bookmyshow.com/")
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        await page.screenshot(path="screenshots/01_homepage.png")
        print("Screenshot taken: 01_homepage.png")

        # --- Step 2: Select Mumbai as the city ---
        print("Attempting to select Mumbai as the city...")
        
        # Selectors for city interaction
        mumbai_button_locator = page.locator('button:has-text("Mumbai")') # Direct Mumbai button in a popup/list
        city_search_input_locator = page.locator('input[placeholder="Search for your city"]')
        city_popup_locator = page.locator('div[data-selector="city-popup"]')
        header_city_display_locator = page.locator('div[data-name="city-selected"] > span')
        list_item_mumbai_locator = page.locator('li:has-text("Mumbai")')

        try:
            # Try to handle a potential initial city selection popup
            await city_popup_locator.wait_for(state='visible', timeout=7000)
            print("City selection popup detected. Looking for Mumbai.")
            await page.screenshot(path="screenshots/01_5_city_popup_detected.png")

            if await mumbai_button_locator.is_visible():
                await mumbai_button_locator.click()
                print("Clicked 'Mumbai' button directly in popup.")
            elif await city_search_input_locator.is_visible():
                await city_search_input_locator.fill("Mumbai")
                await page.wait_for_timeout(1000) # Small pause for suggestions to load
                await page.keyboard.press("Enter") # Select the first suggestion
                print("Typed 'Mumbai' and pressed Enter in city search input.")
            elif await list_item_mumbai_locator.is_visible():
                await list_item_mumbai_locator.click()
                print("Clicked 'Mumbai' from a list item in popup.")
            else:
                raise ValueError("Could not find a method to select Mumbai in popup.")

        except expect.TimeoutError:
            print("No immediate city selection popup detected. Checking header city selection.")
            # If no popup, check if city is already selected or needs to be changed via header
            if await header_city_display_locator.is_visible(timeout=5000):
                current_city_text = await header_city_display_locator.text_content()
                print(f"Current city displayed in header: {current_city_text}")
                if "Mumbai" not in current_city_text:
                    await header_city_display_locator.click() # Click to open city selection dialog
                    print("Clicked current city in header to change it.")
                    await city_popup_locator.wait_for(state='visible', timeout=5000)
                    
                    if await mumbai_button_locator.is_visible():
                        await mumbai_button_locator.click()
                        print("Clicked 'Mumbai' button after opening city selector from header.")
                    elif await city_search_input_locator.is_visible():
                        await city_search_input_locator.fill("Mumbai")
                        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
                        await page.keyboard.press("Enter")
                        print("Typed 'Mumbai' and pressed Enter in city search input after opening from header.")
                    elif await list_item_mumbai_locator.is_visible():
                        await list_item_mumbai_locator.click()
                        print("Clicked 'Mumbai' from a list item after opening from header.")
                    else:
                        raise ValueError("Could not find a method to select Mumbai after opening city selector from header.")
                else:
                    print("Mumbai already seems to be selected or visible as the city in header.")
            else:
                print("Could not find a clear city selection mechanism on the page.")
                raise ValueError("Failed to select Mumbai. No city selection UI found.")
        
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        await page.screenshot(path="screenshots/02_mumbai_selected.png")
        print("Screenshot taken: 02_mumbai_selected.png (after city selection)")
        
        # --- Handle any persistent popups (e.g., promotional) --- 
        try:
            close_popup_button = page.locator('.modal-close-button, .close-button, [aria-label="Close"]', has_text='No Thanks').first
            if await close_popup_button.is_visible(timeout=3000):
                print("Found a generic close popup button, attempting to close.")
                await close_popup_button.click()
                await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
                await page.screenshot(path="screenshots/02_1_after_popup_closed.png")
                print("Screenshot taken: 02_1_after_popup_closed.png")
        except expect.TimeoutError:
            print("No generic popup close button found after city selection.")

        # --- Step 3: Search for Movie "Border 2" ---
        print("Searching for the movie 'Border 2'...")
        
        # Click the search icon/button in the header
        search_icon = page.locator('div[data-qa-id="search-icon"], [aria-label="Search button"], button.search-button').first
        await search_icon.wait_for(state='visible', timeout=10000)
        await search_icon.click()
        print("Clicked search icon.")
        
        # Wait for the search input field to become visible and interactable
        search_input_field = page.locator('input[placeholder="Search for Movies, Events, Plays, Sports and Activities"]').first
        await search_input_field.wait_for(state='visible', timeout=10000)
        await search_input_field.fill("Border 2")
        print("Typed 'Border 2' into the search field.")
        
        # Wait for search results to appear and click on "Border 2"
        # Using a more specific selector for the movie result link
        movie_result_locator = page.locator('a[href*="/border-2/"] div.sc-kghonf.kFmQcZ:has-text("Border 2"), a[href*="/border-2/"] div:has-text("Border 2")').first
        await movie_result_locator.wait_for(state='visible', timeout=10000)
        await page.screenshot(path="screenshots/03_movie_search_results.png")
        print("Screenshot taken: 03_movie_search_results.png")
        await movie_result_locator.click()
        print("Clicked on 'Border 2' movie result.")
        
        # --- Step 4: Check for available shows ---
        print("Navigated to movie details page. Checking for show availability...")
        # Wait for an element that signifies show information, e.g., "Book Tickets" button or show dates
        book_tickets_button = page.locator('button:has-text("Book Tickets")')
        show_dates_section = page.locator('div.date-selector-container, div.showtime-filters-container')

        await expect(book_tickets_button.or_(show_dates_section)).to_be_visible(timeout=15000)
        
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        await page.screenshot(path="screenshots/04_show_availability.png")
        print("Screenshot taken: 04_show_availability.png")
        
        print("Successfully navigated to Border 2 movie page and found show availability section.")

    except expect.TimeoutError as e:
        print(f"Playwright Timeout Error: {e}")
        if page:
            await page.screenshot(path="screenshots/error_timeout.png")
            print("Screenshot taken: error_timeout.png")
        print("A timeout occurred. The element might not have appeared in time or the selector is incorrect.")
    except ValueError as e:
        print(f"Script Logic Error: {e}")
        if page:
            await page.screenshot(path="screenshots/error_logic.png")
            print("Screenshot taken: error_logic.png")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An unexpected error occurred: {e}")
        if page:
            await page.screenshot(path="screenshots/error_unexpected.png")
            print("Screenshot taken: error_unexpected.png")
    finally:
        if browser:
            await browser.close()
            print("Browser closed.")
        if playwright_instance:
            await playwright_instance.stop()
            print("Playwright instance stopped.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
